notes: Covered all 15 candidates: ten discovery journals and five diamond-expansion journals. Read the current fee audit for context; no fee, eligibility, format or scope field is changed by these patches.

Difficulty is an explicitly labelled agent judgment about contribution requirements within each named scientific specialty. Seven high bands reflect demanding stated novelty/significance/breadth/comparative-method criteria; eight remain unknown. No cross-discipline prestige ladder, easy category or manuscript-specific acceptance probability is established. Article-type-specific higher thresholds are distinguished from ordinary research papers.

The 29 retained metric objects all have numeric values, explicit metric years, populations and official source URLs. Only publisher-reported values are retained; no metric is calculated from throughput. JIF and CiteScore describe journal citation patterns, not selectivity, article quality or acceptance chances. Their windows describe the metric definition; underlying raw denominator counts are unavailable unless stated.

Access limits: IOPscience metrics pages were robots-restricted; official IOP China pages supplied dated bibliometrics, sometimes only indexed text because direct retrieval returned HTTP 403. MSMSE and Journal of Physics A retain explicitly historical 2024 JIFs, not invented 2025 values. Current CQG 2025 JIF was readable on the official regional page. RSC scope/guidance and JIF evidence was available as indexed official text but direct pages returned HTTP 403; these provisional assessments identify search_snippet access.

Journal of Computational Physics official pages were HTTP 403. Indexed official homepage scope was available, but its JIF/CiteScore and workflow figures lacked a verified period or full cohort definition and remain audit-note context only. No journal-independent directory statistics or unofficial acceptance estimates were used.

IUCr Acta A and B about pages explicitly report 2025 acceptance rates of 62% and 64% and submission counts of 94 and 92. The acceptance denominators and cohort rules are not defined. These independent reported facts do not license multiplying rates by submissions, dividing publications by submissions, or forecasting manuscript odds. Undated Scopus and Eigenfactor blocks were excluded.

TUBITAK publisher list explicitly supplies the 2025 JIF year; current journal homepages omit metric years for CiteScore, so those values are notes only. Beilstein statistics explicitly mark the 2025 Google Scholar h5-index unpublished; no null or guessed metric was retained. Unverified periods and missing acceptance statistics remain visible as limitations.

Checked live official sources on 2026-11-16. This ranking audit assesses directory evidence and editorial contribution demands; it is not a journal commitment, human scientific review or an authorization for new physical laboratory work.
